description: Working as part of a cross-functional team to modernize the TIQM (Toluna Insight Questionnaire Manager) survey platform from legacy MVC architecture to a modern microservice ecosystem. Contribute across backend service development, cloud infrastructure, and frontend survey flows — all within a large-scale market research product used by global clients.
highlights: Migrating TIQM from MVC to microservices as part of a team of 3 senior devs and a team lead — spanning orchestration (Cambridge), solution management (Lexicon), and user metadata (Thesaurus) services
Developed and maintained backend services covering the full survey lifecycle: creation, update, duplication, retrieval, and validation workflows
Delivered the AdReview custom survey flow in React and TypeScript without disrupting existing legacy survey paths, working closely with UI/UX and stakeholders
Supported serverless cloud infrastructure on AWS Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and S3 with Terraform-managed deployments and CI/CD pipelines

description: Contributed to two major platform tracks: the Dashboard Platform — three connected tools (Admin, Scorecard, Visual Library) used by stakeholders to manage client project metadata, KPIs, ads, and surveys — and a greenfield Kafka-based Consumer Platform for real-time DMP event processing. Worked across backend APIs, SQL data layers, and frontend UI components.
highlights: Supported three connected dashboard tools (Admin, Scorecard, Visual Library) handling KPI management, scorecard uploads across multiple workflows, and client-facing data visualization
Built a new Kafka-based event-consumption platform from scratch — ingesting DMP events from AKHQ, processing and transforming them, and feeding the dashboard platform in real time
Developed and maintained features across the full event-processing pipeline including backend services, data persistence, and frontend display
Delivered ongoing feature enhancements and platform improvements as part of the team's release cycle

description: Worked on a diverse set of projects at ICT Group's Eindhoven office spanning medical software modernization, mixed reality prototyping, and decentralized data research. Gained broad experience across healthcare systems integrations, cloud-connected IoT experiences, and emerging W3C web standards — all within Agile delivery teams.
highlights: Developed and modernized the Meditop medical system — migrating the legacy VB6 application to C#/.NET with REST APIs, HL7 healthcare messaging, and Leadtools imaging integration
Built a HoloLens mixed reality POC: a speech-driven Q&A bot deployed to Azure Bot Service with Unity scenes for immersive voice-response visualization
Developed a decentralized Solid Server POC applying W3C Linked Data principles and Turtle syntax for semantic data representation
Worked in Agile sprints delivering production features for healthcare workflows and experimental prototypes across mixed reality and data research domains

description: Contributed to backend systems at Talabat — a leading food delivery platform in the Gulf region and part of Delivery Hero. Focused on restaurant menu integration and order-posting workflows that connected Talabat's platform with diverse partner restaurant systems operating in different data formats.
highlights: Processed restaurant menu data in XML and JSON formats — deserializing into internal Talabat objects and transforming to standardized platform-compatible structures
Built generic and reusable integration models to onboard multiple restaurant clients with different menu formats and data schemas
Developed order-posting flows that retrieved orders from the Talabat database, serialized to XML or JSON, and dispatched them to external restaurant systems
Improved integration reliability and scalability across the partner restaurant ecosystem

description: Maintained and enhanced a suite of 5 internal business applications covering HR, Payroll, Medical, Attendance, and Construction operations for one of Egypt's leading publishing and education companies. Worked across both ASP.NET web and Windows Forms desktop applications to improve functionality, stability, and day-to-day business workflows.
highlights: Supported 5 core internal systems — HR, Payroll, Medical, Attendance, and Construction — used daily across the organization
Delivered new features and bug fixes for both web (ASP.NET Web Forms) and desktop (Windows Forms) applications
Contributed to performance improvements, system stability, and ongoing platform support across all business domains

description: First professional software development role — built multiple websites and web applications for clients across various business domains and industries. Participated in the full development lifecycle from requirements gathering through implementation, testing, and post-launch support.
highlights: Developed multiple client-facing web applications and internal tools across a range of business domains and industry verticals
Participated in requirements gathering, implementation, testing, and ongoing maintenance for each delivered project
Built foundational expertise in .NET web development, SQL Server, and desktop application development under senior engineering guidance

description: A monorepo portfolio platform built as a genuine engineering exercise. Four-layer Clean Architecture .NET 10 Minimal API on the backend; Next.js 15 App Router with ISR, three-locale support (EN/AR/NL), RTL layout, and dark mode on the frontend.
highlights: Designed and enforced Clean Architecture layer boundaries via .csproj project references
Built a Repository Pattern over JSON content files with IMemoryCache (15-min TTL)
Implemented three-locale routing with next-intl including full RTL support for Arabic
Structured as a real-world monorepo with npm workspaces and shared TypeScript packages
